profile_status: partial; selected tables transcribed; not a consolidated code
important_note: Only selected provisions from user-supplied RMP 2015 and amendments are configured. The FAR engine uses the table structure: road width determines the road-based FAR candidate and, where the table also states plot-area bands, the plot-area FAR limit caps that candidate; this follows Regulation 3.4(iii)-(iv) in the supplied RMP. Every result is a rule-based candidate subject to zone/jurisdiction and current-notification verification. For a category without a configured operative table, no maximum FAR is invented.

Height-band reading from the supplied Table 9; confirm the applicable row and definition with the authority.

single_plot_chapter_6a.condition: Only if this is an eligible single-plot approval under Chapter 6-A and the provision is applicable; check property-record identity, registered deed history and prior approval/grandfather provisions.

land_use_categories.label: Residential (Main)
conditions: Confirm exact Residential (Main) zoning from the notified land-use map.
For apartment eligibility, check the current ring-specific plot-size/unit-count conditions and minimum access-road requirements.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Road-width FAR candidate capped by the FAR limit for the plot-area band; if the road is narrower than a FAR band requires, use the FAR corresponding to the actual road width, subject to the plot-area cap. Derived from RMP 2015 Regulation 3.4(iii)-(iv).

land_use_categories.label: Residential (Mixed)
conditions: Profile applies to Residential (Mixed) zone and plots up to 20,000 m² as stated in Table 12.
Check Table 11 for conditions governing ancillary uses as main use.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: FAR selected by actual road-width band, within Table 12's stated plot-area limit.

land_use_categories.label: Commercial (Central)
conditions: Only applies if the property is officially classified Commercial (Central).
Table 13 includes small-site setback exceptions; verify the applicable size band and front-side treatment.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Table 13 states maximum FAR 2.50 and ground coverage 75%; confirm zone and applicable amendments.

land_use_categories.label: Commercial (Business)
conditions: Table 14 is stated for plot areas up to 12,000 m².
At exactly 9.0 m road width the supplied table wording leaves a boundary ambiguity between 'less than 9' and 'above 9 to 12'; authority interpretation is required.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: FAR is selected from Table 14 by road-width band, subject to the stated 12,000 m² table scope.

land_use_categories.label: Mutation Corridors (Commercial)
conditions: Amendment UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E) changes Table 15 plot-size limit from 12,000 to 10,000 m².
Must be officially designated Mutation Corridor and satisfy frontage/depth/access eligibility; SiteIQ cannot determine that from road width alone.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Road-width FAR candidate only if the Mutation Corridor designation and Table 15 eligibility are confirmed.

land_use_categories.label: Commercial Axes (inherits surrounding zone)
conditions: FAR/coverage are the same as the surrounding main zone; user must select the officially verified surrounding zone.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: No independent FAR; inherits from the surrounding zone.

land_use_categories.label: Industrial (General)
conditions: Table 16 FAR and special setbacks apply only after Industrial (General) classification is confirmed.
For buildings where the specified special setbacks do not leave a meaningful building area, the authority may require Table 8/9 setbacks.
T3 as a main use is subject to road-width condition in the source text.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: FAR is selected by plot-area band under Table 16; no road-width band is stated in that FAR table.

land_use_categories.label: Industrial (Hi-Tech)
conditions: Confirm the official Industrial (Hi-Tech) zone and any permitted residential-main-use exception noted in the source.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Road-width FAR candidate capped by Table 17 plot-area band.

land_use_categories.label: Public and Semi-public (P&SP)
conditions: Confirm P&SP classification and proposed use; ancillary use is separately limited by the source regulation.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Table 18 FAR is selected by plot-area band.

land_use_categories.label: Traffic and Transportation (T&T)
conditions: Table 19's independent Multi-Level Car Parking provision is a special case and is not automatically calculated as generic FAR.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Table 19 FAR is selected by plot-area band for the general Traffic and Transportation zone; MLCP needs a separate authority/fire/airport check.

land_use_categories.label: Public Utilities (PU)
conditions: Utility buffers and development rules are determined by competent authority; no generic FAR is configured.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: No generic FAR can be calculated from the configured source; authority decision required.

land_use_categories.label: Park and Open Space (P)
conditions: This category includes environmental conservation features and reservations. New development is highly restricted; verify lake/drain/valley overlays and any existing permission.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: No generic building FAR; the source specifies permitted uses and limited special cases rather than a general FAR table.

land_use_categories.label: Agricultural Land Zone (AG)
conditions: Coverage and height depend on the proposed use; rural development within 250 m of Gramathana has a separate FAR 1.0 / G+1 condition if eligibility is established.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: No generic FAR for all agricultural uses; choose and verify the applicable use-specific provision.

land_use_categories.label: Unclassified Use (UC)
conditions: Discrepancies in boundaries/land use and development decisions are referred to the authority/government under the source text.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: No generic FAR; authority decision required.

land_use_categories.label: Residential Development Plan (>10,000 m² pathway)
conditions: The 2025 amendment redefines Development Plan for a single plot over 10,000 m². Chapter 7 requires a separate fully checked rule path.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: The standard small/medium plot FAR tables are not used for this approval pathway; Chapter 7 configuration is incomplete.

land_use_categories.label: Non-residential Development Plan / Flatted Factory (>10,000 m² pathway)
conditions: Use Chapter 7 and current amended definition/threshold. The complete specific FAR table for the applicable pathway is not configured in this MVP.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: The standard zone tables are not enough; Chapter 7 review is required.

setback_table8_area_bands.note: Table 8: site area up to 60 m²; side setback of 0.60 m on any one side.
Table 8: above 60 m² up to 150 m²; side setback of 0.70 m on any one side.
Table 8: above 150 m² up to 250 m².
Table 8: above 250 m² up to 4,000 m²; percentage setbacks use site depth and width at varying points. Nominal dimensions alone do not define an irregular-site envelope.
Amended Table 8: for site area above 4,000 m², minimum setback of 5.0 m on all sides.

coverage_amendment.applies_to: Chapter 4 main land-use zone ground-coverage regulations
coverage_amendment.status: coverage provisions mentioned in Chapter 4 shall not be considered for plots up to 4,000 m² under the supplied 5 January 2026 amendment; do not present legacy coverage percentages as a hard cap for these plots.

up_to_4000.logic: For plots up to 4,000 m², basement setback is the building setback under Table 8/9 or 2.0 m, whichever is less; when the minimum building setback is more than 2.0 m, basement may extend on all sides except the road-abutting side, while retaining at least 2.0 m from the boundary on non-road sides.
up_to_4000.note: Apply only where the option's building setback is based on Table 8/9 and road-facing edge(s) have been identified; confirm any special-zone provision and interpretive questions with the authority.

industrial_table16_amended_note: Table 16 was substituted by UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E), dated 05.01.2026. For up to 500 m² the front setback is 12% of site depth and rear/sides 8% of site depth/width; remaining area bands retain specified fixed distances. Verify applicability and current consolidated text.
